description: This file defines the RouteMatch class in Drupal, which implements routing result handling, including storing route information, parameters, and creating RouteMatch instances from HTTP requests.

classes.name: RouteMatch
classes.description: Represents the result of routing, storing route name, route object, parameters, and raw parameters, with methods to access these and create instances from requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a RouteMatch object with route name, route object, parameters, and raw parameters, filtering parameters based on route variables.

methods.name: createFromRequest
methods.description: Creates a RouteMatch instance from an HTTP request, extracting route information and raw variables.

methods.name: getRouteName
methods.description: Returns the name of the matched route.

methods.name: getRouteObject
methods.description: Returns the route object associated with the match.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a specific parameter by name.

methods.name: getRawParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a raw parameter by name.

methods.name: getParameterNames
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter names for the current route, including defaults not starting with '_'.
